Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Lawrence
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 378 as introduced will increase salary expenses of the Wilcox County Board of Registrars paid from the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $12,500 annually. This bill could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the board from the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 378 as passed the House of Representatives will increase salary expenses of the Wilcox County Board of Registrars paid from the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $12,500 annually. This bill could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the board from the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
